claims.claim: The technical validation call lasted 10 minutes.
claims.why: CRM demo times show 11:00 to 11:10; transcript runs to about 10:10.

claims.claim: Simone Achebe is Director of Clinical Data and the champion; Wes Hollis is Senior Data Engineer and technical evaluator.
claims.why: Titles in transcript; roles in CRM contacts.

claims.claim: Theo demoed the customer's own trial extract.
claims.why: Theo says this is the trial extract you sent.

claims.claim: Nightly loads are versioned, so data can be viewed as of any date.
claims.why: Theo said each load is versioned and shows data on any date.

claims.claim: Any version can be restored, and the restore itself is logged.
claims.why: Stated directly by Theo.

claims.claim: The audit trail records every query, export and policy change with who, when and from where.
claims.why: Stated directly by Theo.

claims.claim: The audit trail logs reads, including user and columns returned for queries against protected tables.
claims.why: Theo confirmed reads are logged with user and columns.

claims.claim: The audit trail can be exported to the customer's log system.
claims.why: Theo said it can be exported to your log system.

claims.claim: Unblinded columns are masked for everyone except the unblinded statistics role.
claims.why: Stated directly by Theo.

claims.claim: Theo showed a blinded analyst's view and the statistician's view.
claims.why: Theo said here's each view.

claims.claim: Role grants can have an expiry date, which Wes wanted for interim-analysis unblinding.
claims.why: Wes asked about time boxing for interim analysis; Theo confirmed expiry.

claims.claim: Simone called it a good fit technically.
claims.why: Direct quote.

claims.claim: Simone said she can't move the deal without Dr. Okafor, the CISO.
claims.why: Direct statement; CISO title in CRM.

claims.claim: Dr. Okafor's availability is unknown and her calendar is a disaster until the audit is done.
claims.why: Simone said she doesn't know when Okafor has time.

claims.claim: The commercial approval path is unclear.
claims.why: Simone said she's not sure who is involved.

claims.claim: The call ended with no dated next step.
claims.why: No date was set; CRM dated_next_step is empty.

claims.claim: Per Simone, Okafor's first questions are always the audit trail and who can see unblinded data.
claims.why: Simone said that's always her first question.

claims.claim: Simone said the read-level logging is what Okafor will ask.
claims.why: Simone said that's what she'll ask after the reads answer.

claims.claim: Okafor has not seen any of the demo.
claims.why: She did not join the call.

claims.claim: Simone said Okafor doesn't read long documents.
claims.why: Direct statement.

claims.claim: Wes asked about rolling back a bad load and time-boxing the unblinded role, and both were answered satisfactorily.
claims.why: Wes said Good to the rollback answer; no objection to expiry answer.

claims.claim: Wes is sending the data dictionary.
claims.why: Wes offered to send it.

claims.claim: Simone guessed procurement is involved and possibly the VP of R&D above a size threshold she doesn't know.
claims.why: Matches Simone's statement.

claims.claim: CISO approval is required for anything touching trial data.
claims.why: Simone said she signs off on anything touching trial data; CRM agrees.

claims.claim: The economic buyer CRM field is empty.
claims.why: CRM economic_buyer is blank.

claims.claim: The deal's ACV is $450K.
claims.why: CRM acv_usd is 450000.

claims.claim: The deal is single-threaded on the champion.
claims.why: Wes is also engaged, so single-threaded is a stretch, but Simone said she can't progress alone; judged as reasonable inference.

claims.claim: The close date is 2026-12-18.
claims.why: CRM close_date.

claims.claim: The business outcome CRM field is blank and discovery recorded only one pain: audit trail spread across systems.
claims.why: CRM stated_business_outcome empty; pains list has one item.

claims.claim: The call did not tie the demo to a business outcome or deadline.
claims.why: No outcome was stated in the transcript.

claims.claim: Full-load scope and effort are unconfirmed because the data dictionary has not arrived.
claims.why: Theo will use the dictionary to scope; flagged as unconfirmed.

claims.claim: The log systems the customer would export to were not named.
claims.why: No log system was named in the transcript; output flags it as unverified.

claims.claim: Marta will send a recap email on 2026-09-30 afternoon.
claims.why: Marta said she'd send a recap this afternoon; as-of date is the demo day.

claims.claim: Theo will use the data dictionary to scope the full load, with no date given.
claims.why: Theo said he'd use it to scope the full load; no date stated.

claims.claim: Marta offered a short write-up for Okafor; Simone said maybe, so it is not agreed and has no date.
claims.why: Marta offered, Simone said maybe; output marks it not agreed.

claims.claim: Simone said Okafor doesn't read long documents, so a one-page summary built around her two questions should be sent.
claims.why: Her two questions and the length concern are both in the transcript.

claims.claim: Email states Simone, we'll send a one-page summary on audit logging and unblinded access that you can forward.
claims.why: Marta offered a write-up and Simone said maybe; the email states it as firm and one-page.

claims.claim: The email offers a 15–20 minute walkthrough with Okafor if she has time.
claims.why: No walkthrough was discussed; the email offers it conditionally.

claims.claim: Theo will come back with an estimate within [X] business days of receiving the dictionary.
claims.why: Theo gave no turnaround; the email leaves it as a placeholder to confirm.

claims.claim: The email proposes a data dictionary date such as Fri, Oct 9.
claims.why: No date was said; the example date is a bracketed placeholder.

claims.claim: The email proposes a 20-minute check-in on a proposed date.
claims.why: No check-in was agreed; the date is a bracketed placeholder.

claims.claim: The email asks Simone who from procurement or R&D leadership is involved and whether there is a size threshold.
claims.why: Grounded in the commercial-path discussion and her uncertainty about the threshold.
